When the symbol is present it returns a CompileResultWAP (a numba FunctionType), which is @njit-callable. The asymmetry is real: the present path produces a JIT-callable object; the absent path produces an untyped Python callable. Numba's type inference inside @njit cannot resolve an untyped Python global and would raise TypingError (something like 'Untyped global name duckdb_create_varint: cannot determine Numba type of <class function>'), not NotImplementedError. Without cres_if_available, @cres would have run that check at module import time and caused a load failure, so the stub's primary benefit is allowing clean module loading on older DuckDB.
